criteria.rationale: Examined the spec, the investigation findings and the regression tests. Verified fact: captureReviewValue refuses more than one match per channel, and the legacy broad session_id regex fails on a synthetic two-event stream while the system/init regex completes on the same stream. Unresolved assumption, explicitly accepted as a residual risk: the historical harne8 stream was discarded, so its exact composition is unproven; the claim is limited to the mechanism.

The change adds one function-local stage variable in RunDelegationTask and a pure formatting function, with no shared state, goroutines or lifecycle changes; the full unit suite passed in the sealed matrix.

The failure field keeps its old message as a prefix and adds a parenthesized diagnostic; the record schema, status values and retention files are unchanged. Grep shows no consumer matching the exact old string.

Capture errors are mapped to a closed six-reason vocabulary plus the stage; unknown errors become a fixed 'private error details withheld' reason (delegation_capture_failure.go:8-14), so the output is bounded and typed. F1 and F2 are low follow-ups on hint precision and robustness.

classifyReviewInterruption, redactReviewCapture and redactedDelegationEvents are unchanged; only the final failure string in delegation_task.go:833 differs. The continuity, attempt-ledger and adapter-containment integrations all passed in the sealed matrix.

The recorded failure now names the agent, event format, stage and a safe reason. The tests assert the session id does not appear in the record, stdout or stderr, and that arbitrary filesystem error text is withheld.

Examined the CLI record and the failure string: the old message is retained as the prefix and no field or exit semantics changed. The repository policy already carries the system/init-only pattern (.pose/policy/delegation.json:188). No migration is needed.

Positive case: the init-only profile completes with output 'task finished'. Negative cases: the legacy profile fails at the session/interrupt recognition stage with the ambiguity reason, and redaction growth fails at the stdout stage with every channel empty or absent. All passed in the sealed matrix (208/208).

R1/D1: the material cause is the single-match rule (review_run_continuity.go:150) meeting a regex that matches session_id in every Claude stream-json event; the old handler discarded the reason. R2/D1: per-stage tracking (delegation_task.go:786-828) and a closed vocabulary (delegation_capture_failure.go) surface agent, format, stage and reason while keeping refusal and discard. R3: the CLI regression reproduces both profiles on one synthetic stream.

The changelog entry (fixed, non-breaking) matches runtime: agent, format, stage, safe reason, the system/init hint, and unsafe output still withheld. The spec trace, final report and investigation report match the code. No operator doc described the old message.

For the reproduced Claude case the message gives a concrete remediation (restrict the session pattern to system/init). For budget growth it names the stdout stage and the budget reason. The hint can mislead for reset-pattern or multi-group ambiguity (low follow-up F1).

R1: TestDelegateTaskExplainsTheLegacyClaudeSessionCaptureFailure reproduces the legacy and current profiles and isolates the session/interrupt recognition stage. R2: the failure names the profile, event format and reason, covered by both CLI tests and the unit test. R3: the regression asserts diagnostic fields that the old constant message lacked.

Compared the diff with the spec's artifact list: implementation changes are limited to delegation_task.go plus the new failure helper and tests. Session capture, byte budgets, retention and live-event guarantees are untouched, matching the non-goals.

Only fixed vocabulary strings are interpolated; unknown errors, including saveReviewSession filesystem errors and regex compile errors that contain the pattern, are withheld. Agent and event names come from policy and are quoted with %q. Captures are cleared before finish (delegation_task.go:831), and the tests assert no session leak and empty retained channels.

The smallest alternative (keeping the generic message) is the defect itself. The chosen change is about 30 lines with no new types, configuration or extension points. Negative space: it does not relax single-match capture or recover output. It would be invalidated if adapters began emitting other actionable errors, which the withheld fallback would hide (see F2).

findings.action: Distinguish session-pattern from reset-pattern ambiguity (and multi-group patterns) before adding the system/init hint, with a test for each.
findings.rationale: The claude-stream-json hint to restrict the session pattern to system/init is appended to every 'ambiguous adapter capture' at the session/interrupt stage, including ambiguity from limit.reset_pattern (review_run_continuity.go:253) or from a session pattern with more than one capture group (review_run_continuity.go:150); in those cases the remediation names the wrong pattern.

findings.action: Replace the string match with sentinel errors (errors.Is) shared by producers and the classifier, or add a test that drives every vocabulary entry from its real producer.
findings.rationale: The closed vocabulary matches err.Error() against fmt.Errorf strings defined in other files; rewording a producer silently degrades the diagnostic to 'withheld'. 'adapter capture is not a bounded reference' and 'adapter reset instant is not RFC3339' have no end-to-end test.
